parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  Every living thing on Earth depends on other living things to survive. This network of dependence is called a FOOD WEB.
content: 📖 Every living thing on Earth depends on other living things to survive. This network of dependence is called a FOOD WEB.

In a food web, energy is transferred from one organism to another. Plants are called PRODUCERS because they produce energy from sunlight. Animals that eat plants are called PRIMARY CONSUMERS. Animals that eat other animals are called SECONDARY CONSUMERS. At the top of the food web are APEX PREDATORS — animals that are not hunted by other animals.

When organisms die, they are broken down by DECOMPOSERS — bacteria and fungi that return nutrients to the soil. Without decomposers, dead matter would pile up and nutrients would be locked away forever.

The removal of any species from a food web has consequences for all others. This is called the DOMINO EFFECT. When wolves were removed from Yellowstone Park, deer populations exploded, overgrazing destroyed vegetation, and rivers even changed course — because fewer trees meant less root systems holding riverbanks in place.
(↑ Re-read the story above to answer:)

Animals that eat other animals are called SECONDARY CONSUMERS. At the top of the food web are APEX PREDATORS — animals that are not hunted by other animals.
When organisms die, they are broken down by DECOMPOSERS — bacteria and fungi that return nutrients to the soil. Without decomposers, dead matter would pile up and nutrients would be locked away forever.
The removal of any species from a food web has consequences for all others. This is called the DOMINO EFFECT. When wolves were removed from Yellowstone Park, deer populations exploded, overgrazing destroyed vegetation, and rivers even changed course — because fewer trees meant less root systems holding riverbanks in place.
dictation: In a food web, energy is transferred from one organism to another.
